# cb:b588

> A finalized thread body is route-tagged at finalization: each paragraph carries zero-or-more `<routes ref="...">` refs, each a canonical artifact id (never a free topic name); refs are multi-valued on one element (no overlapping tags); the routed-to sink document is the aggregating ref and incidental belief/code ids are non-aggregating back-links; tagging runs on the frozen body as a motion of the same pass that routes content and updates the ledger.

**Type:** prescription · **Kind:** convention · **Domain:** system · **Status:** active
**Tags:** `nursery`, `threads`, `provenance`, `route-tagging`, `lifecycle:recurring`
**Created:** 2026-07-06
